example.title: The Mary Jane: three-storey apartment block over open parking
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A c. 1970 three-storey apartment block raised on pilotis over open tuck-under parking: white stucco with a tall slate-blue panel, balconies with patterned blue-and-white rail panels, lettered name 'The Mary Jane' on the wall. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
